latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — convert still images into shareable videos via a fast, cloud-based workflow.

- Upload up to three JPG images and describe your desired video; receive a 1080p MP4 clip in 30–60 seconds.
- Automatic backend connection/authorization with free starter credits for new users.
- No timeline editing or export settings required; natural language controls the output.
- Supports quick exports, credit checks, and timeline previews using plain text commands.
- Handles a range of formats (mp4, mov, avi, gif, etc.) with session persistence for iterative editing.
